recentItems.title: Alyssa Edwards Proves Why SURVIVOR Is the Ultimate Binge-Watch | Hear Me Out | CBS
recentItems.description:
In Episode 2 of CBS's digital series HEAR ME OUT, RuPaul’s Drag Race Global All Stars winner Alyssa Edwards convinces host Jay Jurden to binge SURVIVOR using five unforgettable clips. From cutthroat blindsides and camp comedy to raw human connection, here is why this iconic reality competition belongs at the top of your watchlist.

HEAR ME OUT is a new CBS YouTube-first digital series where celebrity superfans convince host Jay Jurden to binge their favorite CBS shows.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #Survivor
Follow Survivor on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/survivorcbs
Follow Survivor on TikTok HERE: https://www.tiktok.com/@cbssurvivor
Like Survivor on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/Survivor
Watch more Survivor HERE: https://www.paramountplus.com/shows/survivor

For over two decades, SURVIVOR has defined reality television, evolving from a bold social experiment into a groundbreaking global phenomenon. Across dozens of unforgettable seasons, castaways have been marooned in remote locations, forced to rely on their wits, adaptability, and resilience to outwit, outplay, and outlast one another. Driven by complex strategic alliances, high-stakes challenges, and surprise twists, the series is a masterclass in human psychology and physical endurance. Hosted by Emmy winner Jeff Probst, SURVIVOR remains the ultimate celebration of legacy and strategy, where players battle for the title of Sole Survivor and the $1 million prize.

Key Questions Answered
* Why should someone who has never watched Survivor start binging the series now? 
* How did the Black Widow Brigade trick Erik Reichenbach into giving up his individual immunity necklace on Survivor: Micronesia? 
* What happened during Angelina Keeley’s viral Tribal Council jacket plea to Natalie Cole on Survivor: David vs. Goliath? 
* Why is Cirie Fields considered one of the greatest players to never win Survivor? 
* How does Survivor foster real empathy across rival tribes during intense physical challenges? 

Timestamps/Chapters
00:00 Welcome to Hear Me Out
00:51 Alyssa Edwards Pitches Survivor
03:18 Clip 1: The Black Widow Brigade Blindside
07:28 Clip 2: Coach on Exile Island
08:48 Clip 3: Angelina Asks for Natalie’s Jacket
11:18 Clip 4: Cirie Fields’ Inspiring Run
12:59 Special Guest Wendell Holland Arrives
15:40 Clip 5: An Emotional Challenge Moment
18:05 The Final Verdict

Play-by-Play Overview
* The Pitch: RuPaul’s Drag Race Global All Stars champion Alyssa Edwards joins host Jay Jurden on his sitcom-style set to pitch Survivor, explaining how befriending Survivor winner Wendell Holland on The GOAT turned her into a mega-fan. 
* The Blindside: Alyssa breaks down Erik Reichenbach giving up his immunity necklace to Natalie Bolton and the Black Widow Brigade in Season 16 (Micronesia), sparking a debate on whether Jay would hold a grudge over losing one million dollars. 
* Camp Comedy & Tribal Drama: Jay reacts to Coach’s dramatic Exile Island monologue before watching Angelina Keeley repeatedly beg Natalie Cole for her jacket after a Season 37 (David vs. Goliath) vote-out—a scene Jay and Alyssa immediately reenact. 
* The Heart of the Game: Alyssa highlights Cirie Fields’ emotional Micronesia elimination and shares how Cirie inspired her never to count herself out. 
* The Surprise & Final Clip: Survivor: Ghost Island winner Wendell Holland surprises Jay on set to discuss life after winning a million dollars. Together, the trio watches a moving challenge moment where Joe comforts Eva across tribal lines during an overstimulating puzzle, officially convincing Jay to start watching Survivor.

recentItems.title: Donnie Wahlberg & Sonequa Martin-Green Play "Cop Pop" | Boston Blue | CBS
recentItems.description:
Donnie Wahlberg and Sonequa Martin-Green play "Cop Pop," a trivia game for CBS's Boston Blue. They share their ultimate summer songs, favorite Shabbat dinner foods, and more!

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #BostonBlue
Follow Boston Blue on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/bostonbluecbs
Follow Boston Blue on TikTok HERE: https://www.tiktok.com/@bostonbluecbs
Like Boston Blue on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/bostonbluecbs
Watch more Boston Blue HERE: https://www.paramountplus.com/shows/boston-blue

BOSTON BLUE is an action-packed multi-generational family drama starring Donnie Wahlberg in a captivating evolution of beloved NYPD Detective Danny Reagan, expanding the universe of the long-running top drama BLUE BLOODS. Reagan’s newfound leadership in the Boston Police Department amplifies his dynamic partnership with whip-smart Detective Lena Silver (Sonequa Martin-Green), whose prominent law enforcement family embraces him as their own.

Key Questions Answered
* What is "Cop Pop" and how do Donnie Wahlberg and Sonequa Martin-Green play it? 
* What does Donnie Wahlberg consider to be the ultimate song of the summer? 
* Which DJ Jazzy Jeff and The Fresh Prince track gets an honorable mention from Donnie Wahlberg? 
* What food does Sonequa Martin-Green wish was served at every Shabbat dinner? 
* How does the cast feel about the catering and beef brisket on the Boston Blue set? 

Timestamps/Chapters
0:00 Introducing Cop Pop
0:26 Balloon Pop One
0:35 Song of the Summer
1:00 Balloon Pop Two
1:12 Shabbat Dinner Food
1:40 Wrap Up and Sign Off

Play-by-Play Overview
* Game Introduction: Boston Blue co-stars Donnie Wahlberg and Sonequa Martin-Green introduce their unofficial game show called "Cop Pop". They explain the rules: popping balloons behind them reveals either blue confetti (representing Boston Blue) or silver confetti (representing Lena Blue), which determines which bowl they draw a trivia question from. 
* First Balloon Pop: The duo kicks off the game by popping their first balloon to reveal a question prompt. 
* Summer Music Trivia: Sonequa asks Donnie to name the song of the summer. Donnie jokingly claims he doesn't know DJ Jazzy Jeff and The Fresh Prince's classic track "Summertime," calling it a close second to his real pick: "Summertime" by his own group, New Kids on the Block. 
* Second Balloon Pop: Ready for round two, Donnie and Sonequa pop another balloon, revealing blue confetti. Donnie reaches into the matching blue bowl to pull a question specifically for Sonequa. 
* Shabbat Dinner Favorites: Donnie asks Sonequa what food she wishes would be served at Shabbat dinner. Sonequa immediately answers with beef brisket, and the two enthusiastically praise their phenomenal set chef. They reminisce about how much the cast genuinely eats during filming, with Sonequa noting that while the rich brisket might lead to a few extra bathroom breaks, it is always worth it. 
* Closing Sign-Off: Donnie and Sonequa thank viewers for tuning in to "Cop Pop," introduce themselves one last time, and sign off with their catchphrase, reminding everyone to "keep it poppin".
